items.title: Harry Edison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Interviewer: Ed Berger with recording engineer Duke Marcos

ctx.x: Interviewer: Ed Berger with recording engineer Duke Marcos Description: Transcript, 93pp.

Just for the record it is now August the 20th. It’s Friday and I have the great pleasure of sitting with Harry “Sweets” Edison in Los Angeles beginning our oral history interview for the Smithsonian. And “Sweets,” we appreciate your taking this time.
